sections.title: Umrah Preparation Checklist
sections.subtitle: Spiritual, mental, and physical readiness before your journey begins.
items: Sincere Intention (Niyyah): Purify your intention solely for the pleasure of Allah Almighty.
Repentance & Forgiveness (Tawbah): Seek forgiveness from the Almighty and resolve past grievances or unpaid debts with family and peers.
Learn the Fardh & Sunnah Rites: Familiarize yourself with the four pillars of Umrah (Ihram, Tawaf, Sa'i, and Halq/Taqseer).
Physical Conditioning: Practice walking 3–5 kilometers daily in comfortable sandals to build stamina for Tawaf and Sa'i.
Essential Duas: Memorize or write down personal supplications, the Talbiyah ('Labbayk Allahumma Labbayk...'), and prayers for loved ones.

sections.title: Travel Documentation & Visas
sections.subtitle: Everything required for smooth clearance through Pakistani and Saudi border control.
items: Valid Passport: Must have at least 6 months validity from the scheduled date of travel and two blank facing pages.
Saudi Umrah / Tourist eVisa: Processed and verified through Iconic Travel & Tours (GL #5247) registered visa portal.
Confirmed Roundtrip Air Tickets: Printed paper copies required at airport check-in desks.
Nusuk App Account: Download the official Saudi Nusuk application onto your smartphone for Rawdah Shareef appointment booking.
Photocopies & Digital Cloud Backups: Keep copies of passports, visas, CNIC cards, and emergency contact numbers in your carry-on.

sections.title: Packing Essentials
sections.subtitle: Curated list of necessities optimized for both holy sanctuaries.
items: Ihram Sets: For men, 2 sets of unstitched white cotton/terry towels, along with an elastic money belt or safety pins.
Footwear: Durable, soft-cushioned sandals (with exposed ankles for men in Ihram) and slip-resistant socks for walking on cold marble.
Personal Care: Unscented soap, unscented moisturizer, lip balm, and sunblock (fragrance-free required while in state of Ihram).
Medical Kit: Personal prescription medicines for the entire duration plus extra 5 days, pain relievers, lozenges, and rehydration salts.
Power & Connectivity: Saudi universal travel adapter (Type G / British 3-pin standard), high-capacity power bank, and charging cables.
Small Drawstring Shoe Bag: To keep your footwear with you inside the Grand Mosque and Prophet's Mosque.

sections.title: Ihram Guidance & Regulations
sections.subtitle: Entering the sacred state of consecration.
items: Preparation: Trim nails, remove unwanted hair, perform full Ghusl (ritual bath), and apply fragrance to the body (not the cloth) before making intention.
Entering Ihram at the Meeqat: Put on the garments before crossing the designated Meeqat boundary (e.g. at your home airport, in-flight announcement, or designated Meeqat station).
Making the Intention: Recite: 'Labbayk Allahumma Umrah' (O Allah, here I am answering Your call to perform Umrah).
The Talbiyah: Chant continuously: 'Labbayka Allahumma Labbayk, Labbayka Laa Shareeka Laka Labbayk, Innal-Hamda Wan-Ni'mata Laka Wal-Mulk, Laa Shareeka Lak'.
Prohibitions while in Ihram: Do not cut hair or nails; do not apply perfume; men must not wear stitched tailored clothing or cover their heads; do not hunt or quarrel.

sections.title: Group Travel Instructions & Protocol
sections.subtitle: Core principles derived from our client brochure: Your Comfort, Our Priority.
items: Stay With Your Group: Always remain in contact with your designated group coordinator. Do not wander away during coach transfers or group Ziyarat.
Punctuality is Sacred: Assemble in the hotel lobby 15 minutes before announced coach departure times to respect the schedule of fellow pilgrims.
Breakfast Timings: Enjoy group breakfast between 06:30 AM and 10:00 AM at the designated ground-floor dining hall.
Identification Badge: Keep your Iconic Travel & Tours pilgrim badge and hotel card with you at all times.
WhatsApp Coordination: Monitor our official group WhatsApp broadcast channel for real-time announcements, weather alerts, and meeting points.

sections.title: Conduct in Makkah & Madinah
sections.subtitle: Preserving the sanctity of the Two Holy Sanctuaries.
items: Keep Focus on Ibadah: Minimize telephone usage, photography, and social media browsing while in the mataf and prayer halls.
Humility in Madinah: Speak in low, dignified tones when entering the Prophet's Mosque. Present Salaam with profound reverence at the Rawdah.
Patience with Crowds: Exercise gentleness, avoid pushing or rushing, and give way to elderly and wheelchair-bound pilgrims.
Zamzam Etiquette: Drink while facing the Qiblah, stand or sit as comfortable, recite Bismillah, and supplicate sincerely.
